name: dsh-plugins-multi-task
description: DSH multi-window wall as an official client plugin: sidebar footer toggle + full-screen wall of every running dsh instance, inside the official web GUI, plus an authenticated gateway for phone/remote access. Install and manage everything via npx: dsh-multi-wall install|start|stop|gateway.

scripts.test: cd harness-src && npx vitest run packages/client/ui-multi-wall
